name: Bitit Bulk Price Manager for WooCommerce
author: bititgroup

sections.description: Bitit Bulk Price Manager for WooCommerce provides a clean administration screen for changing WooCommerce prices in bulk. The interface automatically follows the WordPress site language and text direction.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate WooCommerce.
  3. Activate Bitit Bulk Price Manager for WooCommerce.
  4. Open WooCommerce > Price Manager.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • Font changed to Vazirmatn
  • Soft shadows on all blocks
  • Improved admin notice styling (pastel colors, thin 4-side borders)
  • Notices moved into plugin header container

1.3.2

  • Notice styling improvements

1.3.1

  • Added translation templates and compiled translations for Persian, French, Japanese, Arabic, German, and Spanish.
  • Added explicit loading of translations from the plugin languages directory.
  • Separated WordPress and WooCommerce admin notices from the plugin header.

1.2.2

  • Renamed the plugin and text domain to a distinctive WordPress.org-ready identity.
  • Replaced stored-data, nonce, menu, style, class, and function identifiers with the unique bitit_bpm prefix.
  • Removed bundled compiled translations so translations can be managed through translate.wordpress.org.

1.2.1

  • Improved request validation, nonce verification, and input sanitization.
  • Removed the no-longer-needed manual translation loader for WordPress.org.
  • Added translator notes for strings containing placeholders.
  • Updated plugin metadata and asset versions.

1.2.0

  • Added a redesigned card-based administration interface.
  • Added WordPress localization with Persian and English support.
  • Added automatic RTL/LTR layout switching.
  • Added WooCommerce dependency checks.
